start.speaker: Aldric
start.text: You killed the thing at the bottom and it killed you back. That is not a loss. That is a receipt for a purchase you made.

r2.speaker: Aldric
r2.text: Four floors. You went four floors and the fourth one kept you. Bring me the plate and I will tell you which strap failed.

r3.speaker: Aldric
r3.text: Down, through, and out. I will not congratulate you, because you will want it again, and the wanting is the dangerous part.

r4.speaker: Aldric
r4.text: The fortress. Nothing forged there was forged for a second winter. Whatever you brought up, I can only make it last, not last long.

r5.speaker: Aldric
r5.text: Ten times now. I have stopped setting the second cup out. Sit anyway.

quiet.speaker: Aldric
quiet.text: The forge is hot. It stays hot. That is the only promise this place has kept.
